decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established construction equipment range in a growing market, the compact dumper is likely to be retained while sales and service are built up.
The articulated construction dumper fits the firm's core application areas and should benefit from its engineering, parts and service network, so an early withdrawal is unlikely.

Although the underground mine rescue vehicle is farther from the core range and likely serves a narrower niche, the firm's underground expertise and innovative orientation still make continuation more likely than withdrawal after only one year.
The compact telescopic loader builds directly on the firm's established offer and customer base, so management would normally keep it on the market unless clear commercial weakness emerged.
